Subject: Tenant handoff: admin ownership and keying plan

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our commitment, I'm handing off the account to Monica (Customer Success) for implementation planning + API key seeding. Quick summary of next steps below so we have a single source of truth: 

- Monica will own the tenant setup and coordinate admin invites.
- Aditya will be the technical point for API key seeding and project namespace creation.
- We'll provide a checklist and a CSV template for admins to seed.
- Target: initial admin invites and API key seed by 2025-11-25.

I've attached a concise checklist and my action items CSV for reference. Monica, Aditya — Elena's team is Novaimpact Health (contact: Elena Soto). Elena, Monica will propose a short 30-min kickoff to run through admin roles and the API key handoff flow.

Please confirm availability for a kickoff window on Thursday or Friday this week.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0126

Attachments: tenant-credential-checklist.pdf (checklist, 2 pages); marcus_action_items.csv (CSV stub)

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the clear summary. Thursday works for a quick kickoff (after 10:00am PT) — Friday is also possible if that's easier for Monica.

A couple of clarifying items from our side before the call:
- For API keys, do you support pre-seeding within a customer-owned project namespace, or do you create keys inside the Redwood-managed tenant and transfer? We need to align this with our security team.
- On admin roles: we'll provide two org admins and one billing contact. I assume the CSV template will be for the admin accounts? Can Monica confirm which role labels map to our IdP groups?

I'll attach a short internal note (admin_list.csv) after I gather the names.

Best,

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you (virtually). I'm Monica, your CS lead — I'll run the implementation sprint and be your primary for the first 30 days. Quick outline of how I propose we proceed: 

1) Short kickoff (30 min) to confirm admin list, IdP groups, and API key ownership model. Proposed slots: Thu 11/20 11:00-11:30 PT or Fri 11/21 10:00-10:30 PT.
2) After kickoff: we will create the customer project namespace in your preferred region and pre-seed placeholder API keys for your engineering team to rotate when ready. If you require keys created in a customer-managed project (customer-side cloud), we will follow the documented transfer procedure — we'll confirm during the call.
3) Deliverables in 48-72 hours after kickoff: a) seeded admin invites (CSV based), b) two initial API keys (labeled "seed/dev"), c) tenant-credential-checklist (signed off).

I've attached a short implementation MOP and a CSV template (admin_template.csv) that maps to our invite API. For IdP mapping, please tell me the exact group name for your org-admins and billing-admins (we map to role names: org_admin, billing_admin, read_only).

Elena: can you confirm the kickoff slot and whether Novaimpact prefers key creation inside Redwood-managed project or customer-managed namespace?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199
